summary: FuelCell Energy filed a prospectus supplement to register up to 12,000,000 common shares for resale by a selling stockholder, which are issuable upon exercise of outstanding warrants dated June 22, 2026. The filing is a routine shelf takedown with no new transaction terms—price, premium, or close date are not stated. The company attaches a legal opinion from Latham & Watkins on share legality. No board recommendation, special committee, or structural changes are mentioned. This is a standard registration proceeding for secondary resales, not a special situation.
